# Promatics Technologies

> > Promatics Technologies delivers AI-powered web, mobile, and enterprise solutions with expertise in AI agents, Web3, IoT, EHR, and cloud technologies.

Promatics India (Promatics Technologies) is a software development company specializing in artificial intelligence, mobile app development, cloud services, and digital transformation. The company offers enterprise solutions ranging from AI strategy consulting and agent development to Android apps, Azure cloud services, and industry-specific platforms for healthcare and ecommerce.

## Key Topics

- AI Agent Development
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Web3 & Blockchain
- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Internet of Things (IoT)
- DevOps & Cloud Services
- Mobile App Development
- Digital Transformation
- Enterprise Solutions
- Intelligent Automation
- UX Design & User Engagement
- Azure Cloud Development
- Healthcare & Ecommerce Platforms

## AI & Intelligent Automation Services

- [AI Agent & Copilot Development Company](https://www.promaticsindia.com/ai-agent-dev): AI Agent development with RAG, LLM integration and enterprise solutions
- [AI Strategy Consulting Company](https://www.promaticsindia.com/ai-strategy-consulting): AI strategy consulting for business transformation and implementation
- [From Automation to Intelligence | AI Development Company & Services](https://www.promaticsindia.com/blog/ai-development-company-from-automation-to-intelligence): AI evolution from automation to intelligent systems with ML and NLP
